en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Senegal–Czech Republic treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner is a company other than a partnership that directly holds at least 25 per cent of the payer’s capital, and a 10 per cent ceiling in all other cases. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Senegal–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 10 per cent source-State ceiling on interest where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with residence-State-only taxation for qualifying government, central-bank, agreed export-promotion institution and qualifying government-guaranteed financing cases. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Senegal–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
